mentions.name: DIY TRMNL BYOS FastAPI server
mentions.description: A DIY TRMNL e-ink display build paired with a self-hosted 'bring your own server' (BYOS) implementation written with FastAPI; the server implementation was asked to become an official TRMNL contribution.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just built myself a DYI TRMNL (https://taoofmac.com/space/reviews/2025/12/13/2200), decided to hack together my own server for it, and (serendipitously) got asked if it could be an official contribution: https://github.com/usetrmnl/byos_fastapi
